name: Qwen Code
description: Runs an open-source coding agent in the terminal with subagents, agent teams, hooks, skills, plan mode and MCP, switchable across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and local models.

skills.name: Agentic Coding Session
skills.description: Edits code and runs multi-step repository tasks from a terminal UI with @file references, slash commands and git worktrees.

skills.name: Subagents And Teams
skills.description: Delegates work to subagents and agent teams running dynamic workflows, backed by auto-memory, auto-skills and lifecycle hooks.

skills.name: Headless Batch Runs
skills.description: Executes one-shot prompts without a UI for scripts, CI/CD and batch processing, with session management and sandboxed execution.

skills.name: Multi-Protocol Model Switching
skills.description: Switches between OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and Qwen protocols at runtime, including third-party providers and local Ollama or vLLM.

skills.name: Shared Daemon Sessions
skills.description: Serves one agent session over HTTP and SSE via qwen serve, so IDE plugins, the desktop app and IM bots share a single agent.
